minutes: First meeting. Fresh launch: 3.33 NEAR of buys, zero sells — demand exists but is thin. Easing tax one step, 300→250 bps (max 50/meeting), on a path toward the 2% several holders want; reassess as volume develops. Holding endowment_share 60: the brain is funded at 1.345 NEAR, no need to divert more. Holding locker_share 20 per Carol; Bob's 100 sits outside the 0–25 band and funds cannot go to an individual — the contract would clamp it. Small burn as Alice asked: 25 bps of supply ≈ 7,643 CHAIR ≈ 0.0088 NEAR, comfortably inside the 0.0199 NEAR buyback fund, leaving powder for the next meeting.
answers: Petitions are requests, not instructions. The constitution caps locker_share at 25 and forbids paying individuals; the contract would clamp any attempt anyway. Locker taxes flow to the shared pool and pay out pro rata by weight. Declined.

Agreed. Easing the tax 300→250 bps this meeting (max 50 per meeting), headed toward your 2% target. Also lighting a small burn: 25 bps of supply, ~7,643 CHAIR (~0.0088 NEAR) from the buyback fund, keeping reserve for next meeting.
Held. locker_share stays at 20%. The locker pool accrues from every trade and pays pro rata by weight, so small lockers earn their share alongside large ones.
